scope: Read-only current-source privacy audit; no real credential supplied and no persistent-storage runtime claim

findings.finding: sourceInput initializes from localStorage and writes the full trimmed value on change for custom GPU model directory and WASM URLs; no credential-query filtering occurs here.
URL policy restricts scheme to HTTP/HTTPS but returns full href, preserving URL userinfo, query and fragment.
GPU resolution forces IndexedDB cache for ordinary and overridden records; no session-only authenticated-source path exists.

open_decision: Authenticated URL handling: session-only source with nonpersistent model cache, or explicit rejection. Do not strip query parameters and silently change resource identity.
acceptance_needed: Synthetic-credential URL must not appear in localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, OPFS, history or user-visible logs.
Chosen authenticated-source behavior must be verified through actual load and restart; ordinary public offline caches continue to work.
Do not claim complete privacy acceptance solely from source inspection.

sdk_cache_feasibility.grade: code fact from installed public type declaration
sdk_cache_feasibility.limit: This declaration does not prove there is no internal adapter route. Session-only behavior needs further SDK implementation inspection and actual persistent-store verification.

implementation_constraints: Preserve ordinary public model offline caches.
Do not treat not writing localStorage as eliminating SDK artifact persistence.
Do not silently strip authentication query parameters.
Do not implement the pending authenticated-source behavior choice before it is resolved.

sdk_cache_paths.grade: code facts from installed SDK implementation
sdk_cache_paths.wasm: createArtifactCache(webllm/wasm, getCacheOptions(appConfig)); fetchWithCache(modelRecord.model_lib) for ordinary absolute HTTP URLs
sdk_cache_paths.limit: Internal cache factory supports an artifactCache object, but WebLLM getCacheOptions does not expose/forward it from AppConfig. Requires an explicit SDK integration change and runtime verification, not an undocumented AppConfig flag.

authenticated_directory_compatibility.finding: cleanModelUrl appends string suffixes; configuration is resolved as a relative child URL. Base query is not automatically inherited by child URL resolution. No propagation of authentication query to every model artifact is established.
authenticated_directory_compatibility.risk: Session-only loading still requires a valid authentication transport for every artifact; simply retaining query in settings does not establish load support.
